purpose: Select one 64K-capable Q4_0 layer placement and hold it constant across active-prompt context tests so context is not silently confounded with placement.

selection_probe.claim_boundary: This selects allocation headroom and placement. It does not prove active 64K prompt usability or produce a context throughput result.

ladder_design.fixed_gpu_layers: selected by the 64K/Q4_0 capacity frontier before prompt configs are frozen

active_prompt_rules.4k_16k_32k: Use approximately 78% of the configured window to preserve continuity with Phase 7.
active_prompt_rules.64k: Use at least 60000 tokenizer-observed prompt tokens plus the declared output reservation before describing the test as near-64K active context.

interpretation: The capacity frontier and active-prompt ladder are separate evidence types.
Q4_0 output differed from Q8_0 at 4K, so long-context retrieval quality must be evaluated rather than assumed.
If near-64K is too slow, pages heavily, or misses headroom, report that operational limit even if allocation succeeds.
